title: Invite-only pilot held together by one evidenced compensating control
pins: A compensating control lowers exposure by exactly one step, only for the scopes and domains it names, and only while its supporting evidence is current.
Because the pilot leans on that measure, its readiness is conditional and the measure appears as an enforceable condition with an expiry and a reassessment trigger.
The measure does not apply to the public scope, which stays blocked; the pilot readiness names that blocked transition.

application.name: Acme Orders
application.description: Order tracker used by twelve named testers from one customer while the team decides whether to launch it publicly.

data_summary: Names, emails, delivery addresses and order lines of the pilot testers' own customers. No card data (hosted checkout).

compensating_controls.description: The API hostname sits behind an identity-aware proxy that only lets the twelve named testers' verified identities through; requests without a session never reach the database API.
compensating_controls.enforced_by: Cloudflare Access policy acme-orders-pilot (allowlist of twelve identities), owned by founder:mari

extra_evidence.scope: The exported Access policy on 16 August 2026, plus one unauthenticated request from outside the allowlist that the proxy rejected. Covers the proxied hostname only; it says nothing about the Supabase project's own hostname.
extra_evidence.aspect: reachability of the data API from outside the tester allowlist

findings.rationale: Row-level security now denies anon reads on public.orders, verified against a non-empty table. The anon write path was never probed: no write-probe consent was given, so the requirement is only partly established.

evidence.scope: Anon reads of public.orders are denied on a table separately established as non-empty. The anon INSERT path was not exercised: that needs explicit write-probe consent, which was not given.

findings.rationale: No error tracking on either side; server errors are printed to a console nobody reads.

evidence.scope: Current working tree only, ruleset obs.no_error_tracking. No Sentry, Bugsnag or equivalent client found in the dependency manifest.

baseline.rationale: Reviewed in the walkthrough of 16 August 2026 with the founder present; nothing contradicting was found in the working tree or the project settings.
baseline.screening_rationale: Screening question answered during the walkthrough: the pilot does not fall into the EU AI Act category this row screens for.

evidence.scope: One reviewer walkthrough of the working tree and the Supabase project settings on 16 August 2026. Covers what could be seen in that session and nothing beyond it.
